description: This file defines API routes for a notes management system using FastAPI. It provides RESTful endpoints to create, read, update, and delete notes, mapping HTTP requests to corresponding service layer calls.

methods.name: NotesService get_notes_service()
methods.description: Provides dependency injection for the NotesService instance, which is configured elsewhere in the application.

methods.name: Note create_note(req: NoteCreate, svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service))
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new note.

methods.name: List[Note] list_notes(svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service))
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list all notes.

methods.name: Note get_note(note_id: UUID, svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service))
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to fetch a single note by its UUID.

methods.name: Note update_note(note_id: UUID, req: NoteUpdate, svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service))
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update a note identified by UUID.

methods.name: Response delete_note(note_id: UUID, svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service))
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete a note by UUID.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^def create_note(req: NoteCreate, svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service)) -> Note:$/

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_note(note_id: UUID, svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service)) -> Response:$/

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.pattern: /^def get_note(note_id: UUID, svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service)) -> Note:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: UUID, req: NoteUpdate, svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service)) /
ctags.signature: (note_id: UUID, req: NoteUpdate, svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service))
